sections.description: Adds to GWND Fulfillment: live tracking from Canada Post, UPS and Purolator, or every carrier through one Ship24 key (status on the order, delivered/problem emails, store alerts), ShipStation tracking capture, more page styles and the full style builder, 4×6 and bulk packing slips, and white-label branding.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

First release of the Pro add-on.

Added

  • ShipStation tab: pick up tracking numbers from ShipStation labels, keep ShipStation's duplicate shipped note private, import from recent order notes.
  • Styles Poster, Split, Banner, Receipt and Route, the style builder, custom CSS, and style export/import.
  • 4×6 packing slips and bulk printing; Branding tab for white-label.
  • Live tracking from carrier APIs is not included for now: customers get a link to the carrier's own tracking page. Updating from a test build stops the old poller and deletes saved carrier keys.
  • Signed updates for this add-on and, until it's on WordPress.org, for GWND Fulfillment.
